newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuania central bank assets rise in August.
newsitem.headline: Lithuania central bank assets rise in August.

text.p: The assets of the central bank of Lithuania maintained their rise in August, recovering further after falling sharply in the wake of a banking crisis at the end of last year, the central bank said on Wednesday.

The bank's assets rose to 3.9 billion litas in August from 3.7 billion litas the month before, the bank said in its latest monetary bulletin. Foreign assets made up 87 percent of the bank's total assets at 3.4 billion litas.
Some 90.5 percent of the foreign assets were in convertible currencies, the amount of which rose by 7.4 percent as the bank bought more U.S. dollars than it sold.
Official reserves also rose for the sixth straight month, reaching $852.5 million, up $48.8 million.

The central bank figures showed that banks remained nervous of each other, with no interbank credits granted during August in foreign currencies and credits in litas rising just 3.2 percent to 67.5 million litas.
